entries.title: Proverbs 3:1
segments: ¶My son, forget not my teaching, and let thy heart observe my commandments;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:2
segments: for length of days, and years of life, and peace shall they add to thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:3
segments: Let not loving-kindness and truth forsake thee; bind them about thy neck, write them upon the tablet of thy heart:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:4
segments: and thou shalt find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:5
segments: Confide in Jehovah with all thy heart, and lean not unto thine own intelligence;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:6
segments: in all thy ways acknowledge him, and he will make plain thy paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:7
segments: ¶Be not wise in thine own eyes; fear Jehovah, and depart from evil:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:8
segments: it shall be health for thy navel, and moisture for thy bones.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:9
segments: Honour Jehovah with thy substance, and with the first-fruits of all thine increase;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:10
segments: so shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy vats shall overflow with new wine.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:11
segments: My son, despise not the instruction of Jehovah, neither be weary of his chastisement;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:12
segments: for whom Jehovah loveth he chasteneth, even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:13
segments: ¶Blessed is the man that findeth wisdom, and the man that getteth understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:14
segments: For the gain thereof is better than the gain of silver, and her revenue than fine gold.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:15
segments: She is more precious than rubies; and all the things thou canst desire are not equal unto her.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:16
segments: Length of days is in her right hand; in her left hand riches and honour.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:17
segments: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:18
segments: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her; and happy is he that retaineth her.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:19
segments: Jehovah by wisdom founded the earth; by understanding he established the heavens.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:20
segments: By his knowledge the deeps were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:21
segments: ¶My son, let them not depart from thine eyes; keep sound wisdom and discretion:

entries.title: Proverbs 3:22
segments: so shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace unto thy neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:23
segments: Then shalt thou walk in thy way securely, and thy foot shall not stumble;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:24
segments: when thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid, but thou shalt lie down and thy sleep shall be sweet.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:25
segments: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the destruction of the wicked, when it cometh;

entries.title: Proverbs 3:26
segments: for Jehovah shall be thy confidence, and he will keep thy foot from being taken.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:27
segments: ¶Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thy hand to do it.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:28
segments: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to-morrow I will give, when thou hast it by thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:29
segments: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:30
segments: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:31
segments: Envy not the man of violence, and choose none of his ways.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:32
segments: For the perverse is an abomination to Jehovah; but his secret is with the upright.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:33
segments: The curse of Jehovah is in the house of the wicked; but he blesseth the habitation of the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:34
segments: He indeed scorneth the scorners; but he giveth grace unto the lowly.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:35
segments: The wise shall inherit glory; but shame shall be the promotion of the foolish.
